name: Bitter Smile. Mii Story Dokidoki Chizu no Tabou na Ichinichi
original_name: bitter smile. みいストーリー ドキドキ千寿の多忙な一日
source:
One summer day, Mii and Yuu are put in charge of running the takoyaki shop Chizu.

Mii, already anticipating being “alone” with Yuu, had been preparing all sorts of naughty little pranks to pull on him. But… things might not go exactly as planned.

This is a short, heart-racing ADV story featuring the popular character Mii from bitter smile.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100719194241/http://products.web-giga.com/goods/2010sm/]the official website[/url]]
translation:
某个夏日，美依和优受托经营章鱼烧店“千寿”。

美依早已期待着与优“单独相处”，还准备了各种色色的小恶作剧捉弄他。然而…事情可能不会完全按照计划发展。

这是《bitter smile.》人气角色美依主演的一篇短小而令人心跳加速的冒险故事。

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100719194241/http://products.web-giga.com/goods/2010sm/]the official website[/url]]
